items.title: Weyerhaeuser (WY) Stock Rebounds As Q3 Results Reveal Profit Strain
items.summary: Weyerhaeuser stock just put in a relief bounce, closing at US$20.35 and up a little over 3% since before the numbers hit. That reaction came after Q3 2026 earnings showed net income of US$61m on US$1.9b of revenue, a clear step down from the prior two quarters and a reminder that profit pressure is the real story. items.title: Weyerhaeuser (WY) Tops Q3 Estimates, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
items.summary: Weyerhaeuser (WY) has released its third quarter 2026 results, reporting net income of US$61 million and earnings of US$0.08 per share, while nine-month profits reached US$379 million.
